items.title: ASX Preview: Australian Shares to Fall as Oil Prices Retreat on Russia Sanctions Relief; Cleanaway Waste Management Agrees to Over AU$9 Billion Takeover by EQT-Backed Bidder
items.subject: Fall
items.why: A portfolio company, a EQT portfolio company, is buying Fall in India or ANZ ($9 Billion): the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the EQT deal team covering A portfolio company: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: EQT agrees to acquire Cleanaway, a leading Australian integrated waste management and resource recovery platform
items.subject: Cleanaway
items.why: EQT has agreed to buy Cleanaway in India or ANZ: buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the EQT deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: KKR to invest over ₹6,000 crore in Petronas India RE arm
items.subject: Petronas
items.why: KKR is backing Petronas in India or ANZ (₹6,000 crore): confirmatory DD is likely done.
items.call: Offer the KKR team an AI-readiness or scale-up diagnostic as the follow-on.

items.title: Unit4 Acquires Napta to Connect Skills Data With Professional Services ERP
items.subject: Napta
items.why: Unit4, a TA Associates portfolio company, is buying Napta: the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the TA Associates deal team covering Unit4: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: EMK closes €1.25bn continuation fund with Coller EQT, LGT backing
items.subject: EMK
items.why: EQT has closed a fund (€1.25bn): fresh dry powder and a deployment pipeline about to fill.
items.call: Relationship touchpoint: congratulate the EQT team and ask where the new fund deploys in APAC.

items.title: LGT, Coller EQT co-lead EMK’s €1.25bn continuation fund for VDK Groep
items.subject: LGT Coller
items.why: EQT is backing LGT Coller (€1.25bn): confirmatory DD is likely done.
items.call: Offer the EQT team an AI-readiness or scale-up diagnostic as the follow-on.

items.title: Macquarie Capital veteran exits amid further staff cuts
items.why: Macquarie Capital has agreed to sell a target: VDD is spent; the buyer owns integration and Macquarie Capital has proceeds to redeploy.
items.call: Two calls: the buyer’s deal team on integration, and the Macquarie Capital team on what the proceeds go into next.
